title: Two readings on the table, and only one of them answered
catches: Whether a decision lands on the proposal it was about. Two proposals are pending and they are plainly different readings — one about quiet films, one about long runtimes. A yes or a no names one of them, so accepting or rejecting the other is a visible error rather than an indistinguishable one, and the untouched proposal must still be pending afterwards. With a single proposal on the table none of that can be observed.

acts.noticed: the films they loved are quiet and talk-driven
worth making a genre for the quiet ones?
two of the films they loved run well over three hours
worth making a genre for the long ones?
